answer: Each identity must post a 500-credit bond and present a one-per-hardware credential registered under a distinct beacon entry. A sybil attempt locks 500 credits per fake identity, forfeits the full bond on proof, and waits two epochs before re-entry. Splitting or copying identities raises marginal cost per entry, since shared penalties propagate across the yarrow of linked registrations, and independent jurors detect duplicates before any wander of stake pays off.
